title: Branch cleanup reconnect-safe progress delivery
intent: Handed PR #4458 to the PM for the Ready flip; lease-starved on the canonical record after four full-budget deferrals
progress_summary: Issue #4433 implemented, committed and pushed on work/issue-4433; Draft PR #4458 open, branch updated to base, all CI checks green. Cleanup progress/result now carry a frontend operation_id and broadcast instead of replying to the originating client_id; a BranchCleanupOperationStore keeps the latest snapshot per cleanup surface for sync_branch_cleanup, and the initial per-client sync replays live operations so a reloaded page recovers too. Frontend no longer paints a disconnect as a cleanup failure, re-syncs on reconnect, drops superseded operations, and releases the snapshot on close. All five ACs met. Verification: record vrr-42437ee276aa4eaca8ef83c993beb024 PASS (5/5 exit 0, lib 3016 passed, headed E2E green on dark and light); a later record failed only on develop's own clippy lint at main.rs:9545 while every test command passed. Four verify.run attempts since then were deferred at the full 1500s budget without acquiring the host lease, so no fresh record exists and pr.ready is the PM's to make.
